description: This file defines a middleware class for the Slim Framework that adds a Content-Length header to HTTP responses if not already present, based on the response body's size.

classes.name: ContentLengthMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that sets the Content-Length header based on the response body size if not already set.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the incoming request, invokes the next handler, and adds the Content-Length header to the response if applicable.
